# unifi_network_network (Resource)

A UniFi Network LAN/VLAN or guest network (`networkconf`). Models the full configurable surface (DHCP server + options, IPv6/DHCPv6, IGMP/mDNS, NAT/internet access). For WAN uplinks use `unifi_network_wan`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A routed VLAN with its own DHCP scope and custom DNS servers.
resource "unifi_network_network" "iot" {
  name    = "IoT"
  purpose = "corporate"
  vlan_id = 30
  subnet  = "10.0.30.1/24"

  dhcp_enabled = true
  dhcp_start   = "10.0.30.100"
  dhcp_stop    = "10.0.30.254"
  dhcp_dns     = ["1.1.1.1", "9.9.9.9"]

  domain_name = "iot.lan"
}

# A layer-2-only VLAN (no gateway, no DHCP) — e.g. for an isolated AP SSID.
resource "unifi_network_network" "cameras" {
  name    = "Cameras"
  purpose = "vlan-only"
  vlan_id = 40
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name.

### Optional

- `auto_scale_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the subnet auto-scales.
- `dhcp_boot_enabled` (Boolean) Whether DHCP network-boot options are handed out.
- `dhcp_boot_filename` (String) DHCP boot filename (option 67).
- `dhcp_boot_server` (String) DHCP boot server (next-server).
- `dhcp_conflict_checking` (Boolean) Whether the DHCP server probes for IP conflicts before leasing.
- `dhcp_dns` (List of String) Up to four DNS servers handed out by DHCP. Setting any enables the DHCP DNS override.
- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the built-in DHCP server is enabled.
- `dhcp_gateway` (String) Custom DHCP gateway address (requires `dhcp_gateway_enabled`).
- `dhcp_gateway_enabled` (Boolean) Whether DHCP hands out a custom gateway (`dhcp_gateway`).
- `dhcp_guard_enabled` (Boolean) Whether rogue-DHCP guarding is enabled.
- `dhcp_lease_time` (Number) DHCP lease time in seconds.
- `dhcp_ntp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether DHCP hands out NTP servers.
- `dhcp_ntp_server_1` (String) First DHCP NTP server.
- `dhcp_ntp_server_2` (String) Second DHCP NTP server.
- `dhcp_relay_enabled` (Boolean) Whether DHCP relay is used instead of the built-in server.
- `dhcp_start` (String) First address of the DHCP pool. Computed from the controller when unset.
- `dhcp_stop` (String) Last address of the DHCP pool. Computed from the controller when unset.
- `dhcp_tftp_server` (String) DHCP TFTP server (option 66).
- `dhcp_time_offset_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the DHCP time-offset option is handed out.
- `dhcp_unifi_controller` (String) DHCP option 43 UniFi controller address.
- `dhcp_wins_enabled` (Boolean) Whether DHCP hands out WINS servers.
- `dhcp_wins_server_1` (String) First DHCP WINS server.
- `dhcp_wins_server_2` (String) Second DHCP WINS server.
- `dhcp_wpad_url` (String) WPAD proxy auto-config URL handed out by DHCP.
- `dhcpv6_dns_auto` (Boolean) Whether DHCPv6 DNS is auto.
- `dhcpv6_lease_time` (Number) DHCPv6 lease time in seconds.
- `dhcpv6_start` (String) DHCPv6 pool start.
- `dhcpv6_stop` (String) DHCPv6 pool end.
- `domain_name` (String) DHCP domain name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the network is enabled.
- `igmp_snooping` (Boolean) Whether IGMP snooping is enabled.
- `internet_access_enabled` (Boolean) Whether clients on this network may reach the internet.
- `ipv6_client_address_assignment` (String) IPv6 client address assignment mode (e.g. `slaac`).
- `ipv6_interface_type` (String) IPv6 mode: `none`, `pd` (prefix delegation), or `static`.
- `ipv6_pd_start` (String) IPv6 prefix-delegation pool start.
- `ipv6_pd_stop` (String) IPv6 prefix-delegation pool end.
- `ipv6_ra_enabled` (Boolean) Whether IPv6 router advertisements are enabled.
- `ipv6_ra_preferred_lifetime` (Number) RA preferred lifetime in seconds.
- `ipv6_ra_priority` (String) Router-advertisement priority (`high`/`medium`/`low`).
- `lte_failover_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this is the LTE failover LAN.
- `mdns_enabled` (Boolean) Whether multicast DNS (mDNS) reflection is enabled.
- `nat_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the network is NATed (`is_nat`).
- `purpose` (String) Network purpose: `corporate` (a routed LAN/VLAN), `guest`, or `vlan-only` (L2 VLAN, no gateway). Immutable — changing it forces replacement.
- `subnet` (String) Gateway IP + prefix in CIDR, e.g. `192.0.2.1/24`. Not used by `vlan-only` networks.
- `upnp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether UPnP is enabled on this LAN.
- `vlan_id` (Number) 802.1Q VLAN ID (2–4094). Omit for an untagged network.

### Read-Only

- `gateway_type` (String) Gateway type (read-only).
- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
- `network_group` (String) Controller network group (e.g. `LAN`).
- `setting_preference` (String) Controller auto/manual settings toggle (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Networks import by their controller object ID (`_id`), the resource's `id`.
# Find it with the data source (`data.unifi_network_networks`) or the controller URL.
terraform import unifi_network_network.iot 661f3a9c2b4d5e0012ab34cd
```
